contradictions.explanation: The indoor speed limit cannot be both 10 km/h and 12 km/h for the same warehouse at the same time.
The yard speed limit cannot be both 15 km/h and 20 km/h for the same warehouse at the same time.

contradictions.quote_a: The high-bay racking provides 2,400 pallet positions within the 2,200 m2 Zone B footprint.
contradictions.quote_b: High-bay racking in Zone B with 2,600 pallet positions receives a documented safety inspection every month.
contradictions.explanation: Zone B cannot have both 2,400 and 2,600 high-bay pallet positions at the same time.

contradictions.quote_a: Each rack bay carries at most 2,700 kg total, including all pallet levels in that bay and the weight of the pallets themselves.
contradictions.quote_b: Any bay found damaged, overloaded above 3,000 kg, or unsafe is system-blocked
contradictions.explanation: The same rack bay maximum cannot be both 2,700 kg and 3,000 kg at the same time.

contradictions.quote_a: It is a thermally separated, insulated enclosure of 300 m2 held continuously between +2 °C and +8 °C.
contradictions.quote_b: Zone E temperature status with automatic and manual readings between +4 °C and +8 °C,
contradictions.explanation: Zone E cannot be required to stay between both +2 °C to +8 °C and +4 °C to +8 °C at the same time.

contradictions.quote_a: Total quantity in the cage never exceeds 4,000 kg at a time.
contradictions.quote_b: hazmat cage total against the 5,000 kg limit
contradictions.explanation: The hazmat cage maximum cannot be both 4,000 kg and 5,000 kg at the same time.

contradictions.quote_a: approval of damaged-goods write-offs up to and including 500 EUR;
contradictions.quote_b: dispositions and write-offs awaiting supervisor decision up to 300 EUR or manager decision above 500 EUR.
contradictions.explanation: The supervisor write-off approval threshold cannot be both up to 500 EUR and up to 300 EUR at the same time.

contradictions.quote_a: The hall operates Monday to Friday on two shifts, 06:00-14:00 and 14:00-22:00, with Saturday morning overtime in peak season.
contradictions.quote_b: The site operates Monday to Friday on two fixed shifts, mornings 07:00-14:00 and afternoons 14:00-22:00, under PR-15 End-of-shift handover.
contradictions.explanation: The morning shift cannot start at both 06:00 and 07:00 for the same warehouse at the same time.

contradictions.quote_a: Returns come back through Zone F only
contradictions.quote_b: The dispatcher books the return, assigns an inbound door from doors 1-4 and a time slot,
contradictions.explanation: Returns cannot be received through Zone F only while also being assigned to inbound doors 1-4 that serve Zone A.

contradictions.quote_a: The warehouse manager owns the system of fifteen written procedures, PR-01 to PR-15.
contradictions.quote_b: Maintenance under PR-10, PR-16 and PR-15 covers all trucks, racking and dock equipment on site.
contradictions.explanation: The manual cannot contain only procedures PR-01 to PR-15 while also requiring maintenance under PR-16.

contradictions.quote_a: system-blocked from picking for disposition under PR-09.
contradictions.quote_b: system-blocked from picking for disposition under PR-11.
contradictions.explanation: Quarantine disposition for the same stock at risk cannot be under both PR-09 and PR-11 at the same time.
